title: Pacing the Cage
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the talk emphasizes the importance of experiencing life honestly and fully, rather than just trying to achieve new ideas or solutions. This involves feeling our real feelings, including pain and suffering, and learning to accept and understand our conditioned human experiences. By doing so, we can find a sense of solid ground and dignity in our imperfections, and awaken to a deeper reality that includes compassion, wisdom, and the beauty of life's complexity.
